The battle resulted in a decisive victory for Ethiopia, with Ras Alula Engida leading the defense against the Italian garrison at Sahati, resulting in heavy casualties for the Italians. This victory was a crucial step in the Ethiopian struggle against colonialism and laid the groundwork for future conflicts, including the eventual Italian defeat at Adowa in 1896.
